name: @cognitive3d/zappar-three
description: Cognitive3D WebXR analytics for Zappar WebAR scenes built with Mattercraft.
author: Cognitive3D support@cognitive3d.com

scripts.build: rimraf lib && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='node_modules/@cognitive3d/analytics/lib';const dst='src/vendor';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const file of ['c3d-bundle-threejs.umd.js','c3d-bundle-threejs.umd.js.map']){const from=src+'/'+file;if(fs.existsSync(from))fs.copyFileSync(from,dst+'/'+file);}" && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='src/vendor';const dst='lib/vendor';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const file of ['c3d-bundle-threejs.umd.js','c3d-bundle-threejs.umd.js.map']){const from=src+'/'+file;if(fs.existsSync(from))fs.copyFileSync(from,dst+'/'+file);}"
